result.topic_en: The top of the page is the closing of a letter draft. The rest, written upside down, holds calculations for the heat-conduction problem: two series for a temperature-like quantity χ_t, one for small and one for moderately large values of t, with remarks on the decimal accuracy of the auxiliary values ψ(n).

methods.what: Series for χ_t valid for small t, in terms of the square root of t and an auxiliary function ψ
methods.quote: $\chi = \chi_0\left(1 - \frac{2}{\sqrt{\pi}}\sqrt{\frac{\beta\beta t}{aa\alpha}}\left(1 - 4\psi\sqrt{\frac{\alpha aa}{\beta\beta t}} + 4\psi 2\sqrt{\frac{\alpha aa}{\beta\beta t}} - 4\psi 3\sqrt{\frac{\alpha aa}{\beta\beta t}} \dots\right)\right)$

methods.what: Fourier-type exponential series in odd squares for χ_t, valid for moderately large t
methods.quote: $\chi_t = \chi_0\frac{8}{\pi\pi}\left(e^{-\frac{\pi\pi}{4}\frac{\beta\beta t}{\alpha aa}} + \frac{1}{9}e^{-9\frac{\pi\pi}{4}\frac{\beta\beta t}{\alpha aa}} + \frac{1}{25}e^{-25\frac{\pi\pi}{4}\frac{\beta\beta t}{\alpha aa}}\right)$

methods.what: Differential of χ_t with respect to the initial value and the parameter ββ/(αaa)
methods.quote: $d\chi_t = d\chi_0\left(1 - \frac{2}{\sqrt\pi}\sqrt{\frac{\beta\beta t}{aa\alpha}}\, y\right) - \chi_0\frac{1}{\sqrt\pi}\sqrt{\frac{\alpha aa}{\beta\beta t}}\, y\, d\frac{\beta\beta}{\alpha aa}$

methods.what: Square-root-of-t approximation for fitting the early observations
Series expansion for evaluating the auxiliary function (probably error-function-like)
Size estimates of the ψ terms, used to justify truncating the series
